components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Specular glass button with cyan edge light; the main action. In the build the lit arc tracks the cursor bearing (simplified here to a full-edge brighten).

components.css: :host{--midnight:#09090b;--navy:#16161a;--glass:#232327;--cyan:#ff4545;--cyan-deep:#c81e2a;--ice:#ffe2de;--amber:#ff8a7a;--amber-deep:#e0352f;--white:#f5f7fa;--muted:#9d9ca3;--success:#34d399;--danger:#ff5a5f;--info:#3b9cff;--line:rgba(157,156,163,0.14)} .ds-btn-primary{--l:255 69 69;position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;height:40px;padding:0 18px;border-radius:12px;font:500 13px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--white,#f5f7fa);border:none;cursor:pointer;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(108,20,26,0.55),rgba(9,9,11,0.55));box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05),0 0 0 1.2px rgb(var(--l) / 0.3),0 8px 20px -12px rgb(var(--l) / 0.2);transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),box-shadow .35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)} .ds-btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05),0 0 0 1.2px rgb(var(--l) / 0.9),0 0 10px -2px rgb(var(--l) / 0.6),0 8px 20px -12px rgb(var(--l) / 0.7)} .ds-btn-primary:active{transform:scale(0.98)} .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ff4545;outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview:
A dark ledger read through glass. Everything sits on near-black midnight, inside translucent navy panels, and the only light in the room is the money: cyan where USDC moves toward the pool, amber where it belongs to the seller or where a human has to judge. The system's signature is the iridescent edge, a 1px border that runs cyan at the top-left, fades to near-nothing along the sides and turns amber at the bottom-right, so a single panel carries both halves of every split.

The world is dense but quiet. Numbers are the heroes: tabular, semibold, and alive (they count to their new value and flash ice when they grow). Prose is sentence-case Inter at moderate weight, set narrow (48 to 72ch). Mono is reserved for real protocol text: addresses, `payTo`, HTTP lines, flags. Motion is one curve everywhere (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) and always means something arrived, moved or settled.

Light follows the pointer. Buttons carry a specular edge whose bright arc points toward the cursor and brightens as it approaches, so the interface feels like a lit object rather than a flat page.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight ground with two faint fixed radial washes (cyan top-left, amber bottom-right).
Translucent navy panels with a hairline border and a soft drop; the iridescent edge on the panel that matters most per view.
Cyan = toward the pool / system; amber = seller's share / human judgement. Never swapped.
Tabular semibold numbers that animate between values.
Mono only for protocol and chain text.
One easing curve; motion reports state changes, not decoration.

rules.name: The Two Lights Rule
rules.body: Cyan means toward the pool or the system acting; amber means the seller's share or a human deciding. A split bar is always cyan then amber/glass, left to right, and the iridescent edge always runs cyan top-left to amber bottom-right.

rules.name: The Opacity Ladder Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is white at reduced opacity (85 / 75 / 70%) or muted; do not introduce new grey hexes.

rules.name: The Protocol-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only on text a machine produced or consumes: addresses, hashes, endpoints, headers, flag codes, `payTo`. Never for labels, numbers or decoration.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the system is uppercase or letter-spaced as a label. Headings are sentences; labels are sentence-case muted text. (Uppercase appears only when quoting a real protocol header such as PAYMENT-REQUIRED.)

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every figure that can change carries tabular numerals so live updates don't jitter.

rules.name: The Iridescent Edge Rule
rules.body: The cyan-to-amber 1px edge (masked gradient border) marks the one hero panel per view (landing console and closing panel, ledger intro, explorer search, seller header), the search field, and the active pill. It is a signature, not a default border; ordinary panels use the hairline.

rules.name: The Lit From Within Rule
rules.body: Glows are inner-and-outer light in the signal's own color, never a dark offset shadow.

dos: **Do** keep cyan for flows toward the pool and system state, amber for the seller's share and human judgement (The Two Lights Rule).
**Do** give exactly one panel per view the iridescent edge; everything else uses the 1px hairline.
**Do** set every changing figure in tabular semibold and animate it with the shared count-up.
**Do** use the single ease cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) and animate with transform, opacity and filter only.
**Do** make active states a single shared pill that glides, rather than per-item highlights.
**Do** step secondary text down by white opacity (85 / 75 / 70%) or muted.
**Do** label testnet mocks and operator overrides in the UI text itself.
donts: **Don't** use JetBrains Mono for anything that isn't protocol or chain text.
**Don't** set uppercase, letter-spaced eyebrows or kickers above headings.
**Don't** use dark offset drop shadows to lift components; depth comes from glass, the edge and inner glow.
**Don't** swap the edge gradient direction or use amber as a generic highlight.
**Don't** introduce sharp (0px) corners or new grey hexes outside the neutral set.
**Don't** animate width/height for progress; grow fills with scaleX.
